literal: Him who does not kill and who abstained from flesh, with folded hands, all living beings will worship.
translation: All living beings will fold their hands and worship the one who does not kill and who abstains from eating flesh.
modern: ஓர் உயிரையும் கொல்லாதவனாகவும், புலால் உண்பதைத் தவிர்த்தவனாகவும் இருப்பவனை, உலகிலுள்ள எல்லா உயிர்களும் கைகூப்பி வணங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme spiritual status of a person who practices absolute non-violence. By refusing to kill any creature (கொல்லான்) and refusing to consume meat (புலாலை மறுத்தான்), a person rises above the cycle of harm. Such an individual radiates peace and harmlessness so profoundly that all living creatures (எல்லா உயிரும்), losing their natural fear, will revere them with folded hands (கைகூப்பி தொழும்). It shows that true greatness lies in universal compassion.
